posts.label: A / sharp clarity gap
posts.text:
Your AI-built landing page looks like a startup.
But can anyone explain what you sell?

I built 3 open-source skills for the story, audience, and offer.

Same facts. Same design. Three pitches.

https://github.com/soohanjazzyun/landing-page-lab

posts.label: B / demo-first
posts.text:
One product. Three pitches. Same facts and design.

Landing Page Lab helps your coding agent explain the product, choose its audience, and clarify the offer.

Open source. Built by Jazz.

https://github.com/soohanjazzyun/landing-page-lab

posts.label: C / problem-first
posts.text:
A polished page can still leave people asking: what is this, is it for me, and what do I get?

I built 3 open-source skills to work through those decisions.

Landing Page Lab by Jazz:
https://github.com/soohanjazzyun/landing-page-lab

posts.label: Story
posts.text:
Your README explains what you built. Does your first screen explain what someone can do with it?

Story starts with the customer's task, then works toward a clear next step.

https://github.com/soohanjazzyun/landing-page-lab

posts.label: Resonance
posts.text:
A page for 'everyone who wants to be productive' leaves the hard decision to the reader.

Resonance asks who this is for, what matters to them, and who should choose something else.

https://github.com/soohanjazzyun/landing-page-lab

posts.label: Offer
posts.text:
Before writing a stronger promise, explain the actual offer:

What do I get?
What must I do?
What are the terms?
What is still unknown?

That's the job of Landing Page Lab's Offer skill.
https://github.com/soohanjazzyun/landing-page-lab

posts.label: RelayNote case
posts.text:
One Product, Three Pitches #1: RelayNote.

Story: revisit the interview.
Resonance: focus on solo founders.
Offer: show the notes-to-export workflow.

Fictional product. Authored examples. Same facts and design.
https://github.com/soohanjazzyun/landing-page-lab

posts.label: Evidence
posts.text:
'Saves 10 hours a week' is easy to write. Where did the number come from?

Landing Page Lab keeps unsupported claims visible as gaps. A better sentence still needs evidence.

https://github.com/soohanjazzyun/landing-page-lab

posts.label: Clinic invitation
posts.text:
Bring a public README, one intended buyer, and one real next step.

I'm inviting Founder Clinic submissions for One Product, Three Pitches. Selected cases get the drafts and reasoning. No star required.

https://github.com/soohanjazzyun/landing-page-lab

posts.label: ShipWatch case
posts.text:
One Product, Three Pitches #2: ShipWatch.

A missed heartbeat is a concrete problem. 'Advanced observability' hides it.

Fictional product. Authored examples. No uptime or conversion claim.

https://github.com/soohanjazzyun/landing-page-lab

posts.label: Workflow boundary
posts.text:
The demo prepares a prompt in your browser. Your coding agent runs the work.

I want the handoff to be inspectable: source facts, decisions, copy, evidence gaps, and what to build next.

https://github.com/soohanjazzyun/landing-page-lab

posts.label: Slotwise case
posts.text:
One Product, Three Pitches #3: Slotwise.

A solo consultant needs a client to choose a time. The pitch should explain that before promising a scheduling revolution.

Fictional product. Authored examples.
https://github.com/soohanjazzyun/landing-page-lab

posts.label: Failure invitation
posts.text:
The most useful bug report for a writing skill:

1. The public source brief.
2. What the agent wrote.
3. The assumption it got wrong.

A reproducible bad decision can improve the next run.

https://github.com/soohanjazzyun/landing-page-lab

posts.label: Comparison question
posts.text:
A better headline can mean three different things:

I understand the product.
I recognize my situation.
I can evaluate the commitment.

Story, Resonance, Offer. Which question does your page leave open?
https://github.com/soohanjazzyun/landing-page-lab

posts.label: Try one skill
posts.text:
You don't need to rebuild your page to try Landing Page Lab.

Pick one skill. Audit one hero. Keep the same product facts, design, and CTA. Then inspect what changed and why.

https://github.com/soohanjazzyun/landing-page-lab

posts.label: Follow the work
posts.text:
Landing Page Lab is built around a small loop: show the facts, try a pitch, inspect the decisions, fix the mistakes.

If that is useful to your work, try a skill or star the repo to follow the next cases.

https://github.com/soohanjazzyun/landing-page-lab
